house.title: Add house
house.description: The house is set up once. It holds the HVAC season, presence and the settings shared by all rooms. Add rooms afterwards.

data_description.season_entity: States: Heating, Cooling, Comfort, Frost protection.
data_description.at_home_entity: Off means nobody is home: heating falls back to frost protection, cooling stops.
data_description.prepare_entity: Optional. When on, rooms in use pre-heat (frost protection season) or cool (cooling season) before arrival.
data_description.notify_services: Optional. Told when an A/C does not switch mode, e.g. mobile_app_my_phone.

room.title: Add room
room.description: Pick the devices that heat and cool this room.

data_description.floor_thermostat: Optional. Set to the highest radiator setpoint of all rooms on the same thermostat.
data_description.schedule: Optional schedule helper. On: comfort temperature and cooling. Off: eco temperature, A/C off. Without one the room is always on schedule.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Optional. Radiators reading higher than this sensor are corrected. Without it the radiators' own readings are used.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Optional. Without it the radiators' own readings are used.
data_description.manual_policy: What happens when someone changes temperature on a remote or thermostat.
data_description.manual_cool_min: Example: 22 °C stops the A/C being set to 18 °C.

bathroom.title: Bathroom
bathroom.description: Devices for the bathroom of this room.

data_description.bath_schedule: Schedule helper. On: bathroom comfort temperature and floor heating.

error.bad_range: The highest value must be at least the lowest value.

error.thermostat_overlap: The floor thermostat must not also be a radiator or air conditioner.
error.no_bath_devices: Select a bathroom radiator or floor heating.
error.bath_overlap: Bathroom devices must not also be room devices.
